svg.aria-label: What happens when you type a URL: the browser resolves the name through DNS, opens a TCP connection and TLS session, sends an HTTP request that passes a CDN or load balancer to the server, and renders the response, fetching more resources.
svg.title: What happens when you type a URL: the browser resolves the name through DNS, opens a TCP connection and TLS session, sends an HTTP request that passes a CDN or load balancer to the server, and renders the response, fetching more resources.
svg.text: Every step is cached somewhere: browser, OS, DNS (for its TTL), CDN.
That is why the second visit is fast.
